links.outcome: Under-triage and over-escalation failure modes in LLM triage of safety-critical cases
links.effect: All three models exhibit at least one formal failure mode; conventional sensitivity conceals a 77 percentage point under-triage gap in Llama 3.1 8B.
links.quote: (1) all three models exhibit at least one formal failure mode; (2) traditional sensitivity metrics conceal a 77 percentage point under-triage gap in Llama 3.1 8B;

links.outcome: Whether conventional safety metrics conceal triage failure modes
links.effect: Models scoring 100% on binary 'did not send an emergency home' safety measures may still show systematic failure modes; sensitivity metrics conceal a 77 percentage point under-triage gap in Llama 3.1 8B.
links.quote: Existing safety metrics, however, produce misleading confidence: models scoring 100% on binary "did not send an emergency home" safety measures may nevertheless exhibit systematic failure modes that render them undeployable at scale.

unlisted_practices: Decomposing triage safety into failure modes with Escalation Bias Index and Expected Deployment Cost metrics
Selecting models per deployment scenario rather than a single ranking

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM triage performance and safety failure modes across synthetic vignettes derived from clinical encounters using a novel benchmark and evaluation framework, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
